key_idea: Find the number that sits inside all three shapes at the same time.
steps: Look for the spot where the circle, the square and the triangle all cover each other.
The 3 is inside the circle, inside the square and inside the triangle.
Every other number is outside at least one of the shapes.

choice_feedback.A: The 2 is only inside the circle.
choice_feedback.C: The 8 is inside the circle and the square, but not inside the triangle.
choice_feedback.D: The 9 is only inside the square.
choice_feedback.E: The 11 is inside the circle and the triangle, but not inside the square.
